mapper.insert: insert into review (order_id, user_id, provider_id, score_professional, score_punctual, score_communication, score_care, content, images, anonymous) values (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{providerId}, #{scoreProfessional}, #{scorePunctual}, #{scoreCommunication}, #{scoreCare}, #{content}, #{images}, #{anonymous})
mapper.select:
select count(*) as totalCount, round(avg(score_professional), 2) as avgProfessional, round(avg(score_punctual), 2) as avgPunctual, round(avg(score_communication), 2) as avgCommunication, round(avg(score_care), 2) as avgCare, round(avg((score_professional + score_punctual + score_communication + score_care) / 4.0), 2) as avgOverall, sum(case when (score_professional + score_punctual + score_communication + score_care) / 4.0 >= 4.5 then 1 else 0 end) as star5, sum(case when (score_professional + score_punctual + score_communication + score_care) / 4.0 >= 3.5 and (score_professional + score_punctual + score_communication + score_care) / 4.0 < 4.5 then 1 else 0 end) as star4, sum(case when (score_professional + score_punctual + score_communication + score_care) / 4.0 >= 2.5 and (score_professional + score_punctual + score_communication + score_care) / 4.0 < 3.5 then 1 else 0 end) as star3, sum(case when (score_professional + score_punctual + score_communication + score_care) / 4.0 >= 1.5 and (score_professional + score_punctual + score_communication + score_care) / 4.0 < 2.5 then 1 else 0 end) as star2, sum(case when (score_professional + score_punctual + score_communication + score_care) / 4.0 < 1.5 then 1 else 0 end) as star1 from review
and provider_id = #{providerId}
